name: open
js: (async () => { await window.GMMCDeploy.open(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); return { open: d.open, title: d.querySelector('.dp-title').textContent, cards: d.querySelectorAll('.dp-card').length }; })()

name: disabled targets
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); return ['docker', 'builtin', 'ssh', 'pages', 'folder'].map((id) => { const c = d.querySelector('[data-target=' + id + ']'); const w = c.querySelector('.dp-why'); return { id, disabled: c.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]').disabled, chip: c.querySelector('.dp-chip').textContent, why: w.hidden ? '' : w.textContent, link: w.hidden ? '' : c.querySelector('.dp-why-link').href }; }); })()

js: (() => { const { parseRepo } = window.GMMCDeployCore; const bad = ['', 'a', 'a/b/c', 'a b/c', '../x', 'a/..'].map((x) => { try { parseRepo(x); return 'ACCEPTED ' + x; } catch { return 'rejected'; } }); const ok = parseRepo('https://github.com/Name/my-map.git'); return { bad, ok }; })()

name: cantonese
js: (async () => { window.I18N.setLang('yue'); await window.GMMCDeploy.open(); const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); return { title: d.querySelector('.dp-title').textContent, docker: d.querySelector('[data-target=docker] .dp-why').textContent, btn: d.querySelector('.dp-deployAll').textContent, chip: d.querySelector('[data-target=docker] .dp-chip').textContent }; })()

name: overflow
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); const dr = d.getBoundingClientRect(); const main = d.querySelector('.dp-main'); const wide = []; for (const e of d.querySelectorAll('*')) { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width && (r.right > dr.right + 1 || r.left < dr.left - 1)) wide.push(e.className || e.tagName); } return { vw: innerWidth, dialogW: Math.round(dr.width), mainScrollW: main.scrollWidth, mainClientW: main.clientWidth, docScrollW: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, escaping: wide.slice(0, 8) }; })()
